summary: General advice for any CGM: when and how to calibrate, how to insert a G6 sensor, and troubleshooting connection problems, sensor errors and jumpy values. The last part fixes a negative sensor age shown in AAPS by deleting a wrong Careportal entry.

sections.heading: CGM hygiene
sections.summary: Rules for blood-based calibration: clean hands, stable glucose, enough calibrations at low and higher levels.

sections.heading: Setting sensor (G6)
sections.summary: How to insert a G6 sensor and click in the transmitter; hardware only.

sections.heading: Connection problems
sections.summary: Bluetooth interference from nearby devices and backfill after reconnecting.

sections.heading: Sensor Errors
sections.summary: What to try when the sensor reports errors: another body site, drinking, massage. 'Sensor Error' is the CGM's message, not an AAPS label.

sections.heading: Jumpy values
sections.summary: Changing noise blocking in xDrip's Inter-App settings, and a pointer to the smoothing page. xDrip labels only.

sections.heading: Negative Sensor Age
sections.summary: Reading the sensor age on the Sensor row of the main-screen status panel, and fixing a negative age by deleting the duplicate or wrongly dated Sensor Insert entry under Treatments history > Careportal.
